x: All three statements are correct. The 7th Constitutional Amendment, 1956, linked to the reorganisation of States, inserted Articles 350A and 350B; the Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities under Article 350B is styled the Commissioner for Linguistic Minorities (office set up in 1957).

C is correct: St. Xavier's College v. Gujarat (1974) protected the right to administer, allowing regulation only for standards and excellence. The others are mismatched: the Article 143 Presidential reference was the Kerala Education Bill case, not P.A. Inamdar; the 11-judge Bench and State-wise minority status belong to T.M.A. Pai; the seven-judge Bench barring State quotas in unaided institutions was P.A. Inamdar.

A-4, B-2, C-1, D-3. In re Kerala Education Bill held the Article 30 right is not absolute and the State may impose reasonable conditions (regulating standards); St. Stephen's (1992) let an aided minority college prefer its own community up to about 50%; T.M.A. Pai (2002) made the State the unit for minority status; P.A. Inamdar (2005) barred State reservation quotas in unaided institutions, minority or non-minority.

A is correct: Ashraya Bima Yojana (2001, LIC) covered workers who lost their jobs. The others are mismatched: hospitalisation cover for BPL families is RSBY (2008), not Aam Aadmi Bima Yojana in 2001; NPS-Lite for unorganised workers is Swavalamban (2010), not RSBY; and Swavalamban dates from 2010, not 2007.
